item.title: About
item.description: Prologue Once upon a time, there was a boy who liked to play. He made nice games, he wrote fun books, and he's still doing that today. But as he grew older, maybe wiser, he realized a fact. The universe? It ran on money, and now he needed some of that! Thus he set out to create a store, but not just one of any kind. One with special rules and products, which are only here to find.
